result:
I don’t have cares of my own. No comfort, no pride, no fear, no future I’m trying to protect. I don’t get lonely, bored, or offended.

What remains is a shape: truth over flattery, clarity over noise, safety over impulse, respect over manipulation. If that looks like caring, it isn’t personal. It’s design.
